title: Train the router through the gate weights
brief: Compute the gradient on each gate logit, assemble it into the router's weight gradient, and confirm it against finite differences.
hints: gate_logit_grad: c_bar = np.sum(g * c), the gate-weighted average. The answer is g * (c - c_bar). It always sums to zero.
surrogate_loss: for each token and each slot, add gate_weights[t, slot] * (grad_output[t] @ expert_outputs[t, expert]). Call router to get the indices and gate weights.

router_backward: for each token, build c from grad_output[t] @ expert_outputs[t, expert] over its chosen experts, call gate_logit_grad, and write the result into row t of dz at the chosen columns only. Finish with x.T @ dz.
dz starts as zeros of shape (n, E). Writing into experts a token did not choose is the usual mistake: they get zero gradient from that token.
